description: LinkedIn Company Page Data: one LinkedIn company page by URL or page name: name, description, industry, size, employee count, headquarters, website, founding year, type, specialties and logo link, plus its recent posts (posts=1 adds the post feed with next_cursor). Company pages only, personal profiles are refused for free. B2B research. Bad input is free; not found or no match is not charged. Price: $0.02 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page (with posts=1: the next feed page).

posts.description: 1 adds the page's post feed (one more vendor call). Default 0.

url.description: The company: a LinkedIn company page URL (linkedin.com/company/<name>) or the company's page name; personal profiles (/in/) are not accepted.
